source_caption_text:
Come for the cars, stay for the music 🚗

‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ drops in just over two months, and today, @atlanticrecords and @rockstargames shared that the soundtrack for the soon-to-be biggest video game ‘Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album’ will feature 34 original tracks. The first six singles (the full soundtrack will be revealed at a later date) are available now, including songs from @pinkpantheress, @travisscott, @fredagainagainagainagainagain, and more.

Swipe through to hear them.
